characters.prompt:
Create one polished high-resolution 2D game sprite atlas. IMAGE 1 is the character identity reference; preserve that person's face, age, skin tone, gender presentation, hairstyle, outfit and colors. IMAGE 2 is STYLE AND GRID REFERENCE ONLY: match its hand-painted shading, crisp subtle outlines, smooth edges and adult chibi proportions, but do NOT copy Maya's face, hair or clothes.
CHARACTER: Jun: adult woman, long straight dark hair side part, ivory blouse, black trousers and black low heels.
OUTPUT: exactly 6 equal columns by 4 equal rows on a square pure white #FFFFFF background. No text, labels, grid, shadows or furniture. 24 isolated complete figures with generous margins, centered within each cell. Row1 front; row2 exact RIGHT profile; row3 exact LEFT profile; row4 BACK. Same head and body scale throughout.
Columns: 1 standing neutral hands empty. 2 walk left foot forward/right back carrying one small ivory research document naturally at waist. 3 passing gait legs close together one knee bent. 4 opposite contact gait right foot forward/left back. 5 opposite passing gait. 6 SEATED naturally with knees bent, feet down, arms resting forward holding document low. For BACK SEATED, faithfully preserve the compact sitting pose from image1: shoulders relaxed, arms in front and paper fully hidden behind torso, NO paper peeking above shoulder or sticking sideways. Do not shrink the head when seated.
Make continuous back and shoulder silhouettes, connected elbows and wrists, fingers around document edges without piercing it. Clear alternating legs with distinct near/far leg shading. No duplicate contact/passing poses. Keep the head, torso and paper still during walking; only legs cycle. Preserve identity in every cell. This is a production art candidate for a research-agent cast, not a portrait sheet.
